tool_args.rationale: The eight rows meet the supplied minimum for the verified two-state memory ODE. Fit its four parameters numerically, reconstruct the initial memory state from each raw history when mem_conv is absent, and integrate forward with RK4 at the prescribed step size.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed s_grad values are zero, but the endpoint-matched history-gap and transient-lag signatures directly support the memory ODE; branch-gradient mechanisms are not the leading ambiguity.
The acquired batch brings the training set to eight rows, meeting the stated minimum for fitting the four-parameter coupled ODE.
They do not represent the observed dependence on pre-switch history and coupled transient lag.
